en: Calls down lightning on several enemy units, dealing damage.
Swiftly slashes several enemy units, dealing damage.
Engulfs several enemy units in flames, dealing damage.
Deals 4x normal damage to several enemy units. The user is also hurt, wounded and confused.
Damages several enemy units on plains, meadows or in woods with a fire attack.
Damages several enemy units at sea, in shoals or on beaches with a flood attack.
Fells great trees onto several enemy units in woods, dealing damage.
Drops rocks onto several enemy units in the mountains, dealing damage.
Damages several enemy units at sea with raging waves.
Sets a bear on several enemy units in the mountains, damaging and confusing them.
Sets sharks on several enemy units at sea, damaging and confusing them.
Reduces the Skill Points of several enemy units.
Attacks one enemy unit and one more enemy unit beyond it in the same line.
Attacks one enemy unit and two more enemy units beyond it in the same line.
Attacks two enemy units within range in quick succession.
Stops one enemy Cavalry or Mounted Archer unit from moving.
Stops one enemy unit at sea from moving.
Stops several enemy units from moving and also lowers their Attack.
Lowers the Attack of several enemy units.

Lowers the Defense of one enemy unit.
No effect on Kunoichi or Kunoichi Chiefs.

Lowers the Attack of several enemy units.
No effect on Kunoichi or Kunoichi Chiefs.

Confuses several enemy units.
No effect on Kunoichi or Kunoichi Chiefs.
Makes one enemy unit unlucky.
Seals the skills of one enemy unit.
Stops one enemy unit from moving.
Steals Skill Points from one enemy unit, up to 80 percent of its maximum.
Fully restores the Endurance of one allied unit.
Restores the Endurance of one allied unit.
Fully restores the Endurance of several allied units.
Restores the Endurance of several allied units.
Restores the user's Endurance when it is in the mountains or in woods.
Restores the user's Endurance when it is at sea or in shoals.
Fully restores the Endurance of all allied units.
Restores the Endurance of all allied units.
Calms the confusion of one allied unit.
Unseals the skills of one allied unit.
Frees one allied unit from being bound.
Restores the lost luck of one allied unit.
Heals the bad wounds of one allied unit.
Raises the Attack of several allied units.
Raises the Defense of several allied units.
Raises the Intellect of several allied units.
Restores the Skill Points of one allied unit.
Swaps the Endurance of one enemy unit with the user's own.
Lets one allied unit that has already acted take another action.
Changes the weather.
Steals all the funds of one enemy unit.
Increases your funds when the user is in a town or village.
Lets the user move further from where it now stands.
Lets the user move further from where it now stands, but it loses Endurance.
When the user is at sea, lets it move further from where it now stands.
Men, follow me!
Eldest brother Takamoto is here! I want only the enemy general's head!

I am Terumoto!
Lord Motonari, watch me!

Motoharu is here!
I'll cut down anyone in my way!

Kikkawa Hiroie is here!
See the valor I got from my father!

Takakage is here!
Behold my plan for sure victory!

Now, we march!
The glory will be mine!

Come, we march!
I'll scatter the enemy!

Our work here will decide
victory or defeat.

Here we go!
No foe can beat my ever-victorious plans!

Watch well the fine art
of my archery!
I'm the Mouri clan's best archer! I'll shoot down the enemy general!

I'll show you archery
the equal of my father's.

First spear's glory is mine!
Drive on to their HQ!

First spear will be mine!
We ride straight for their camp!

My name is Iida Yoshitake!
Behold my prized spearwork!

Where's the enemy?!
I, Narikata, will face you!

Nomi Munekatsu, that's me!
I'll show you how pirates fight!
Let me show you the power of the Buddha.
note: Officer #18 Ankokuji Ekei (monk). The Japanese has a stray break before the final 。; no break in English.

en:
With this bow, I'll seize victory!
We march!

I'm right here with you!
Fight to your heart's content!
My one aim: the enemy general's head! I'll put an arrow through it!
Heh... Let me show you the secrets of the ninja arts.

To battle! Let's go!
I won't yield the glory to anyone!

I am Takaie of Goryu Castle!
Face me! Face me!

Battle at last...
My blood is stirring...
Whoever blocks the Mouri advance will be rust on my blade!

The battle begins...
I'm shaking with excitement...

None can stand before me!
You lowborn dogs! Prepare to die!
